without changing its STEP bytes: Open CASCADE Technology's sample
[data/step/linkrods.step](https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/blob/7fd59977dfb3a75f75670474b59dfc0f3f5f90ba/data/step/linkrods.step)
(`7fd5997`, 2011-03-16). A ø1.5 boss bounds the part's left and front box sides with its round
face, and its ⌀1.034 hole is the natural origin for the ⌀0.440 hole in the other boss.
